reason: A DSH plugin that bridges image inputs to a configured vision model, injects pixel-coordinate descriptions into conversations, and supports follow-up image questions and configuration through a settings page.

summaries.zh: 将用户图片交给已配置的视觉模型分析，并把带像素坐标的文字描述注入对话，支持图片追问和设置管理。
summaries.en: Analyzes user-provided images with a configured vision model, injects pixel-coordinate descriptions into conversations, and supports follow-up questions and settings management.

capabilities: Analyzes user-provided images through a configured vision model
Replaces image message blocks with generated textual descriptions in the conversation context
Provides a vision_ask tool for follow-up image questions using attachment IDs or local image paths
Persists plugin configuration and exposes settings-related RPC operations
